governing_standard: W33 Golden Learning & Assessment Standard v1.0

findings.title: Canonical Audio Generator Hardcoded Learner-Facing Spoken Strings
findings.root_cause: read_social.mp3 and info_exchange_q1..q4 were hardcoded as string literals in scripts/generate_w33_audio_canonical.mjs.
findings.impact: Risk of silent drift between data hubs and synthesized audio.
findings.evidence: read.js now formally exports social_story; generate_w33_audio_canonical.mjs dynamically imports from read.js and speaking_hub.js.
findings.required_fix: Add social_story to read.js; dynamic binding in canonical generator.
findings.closure_criteria: 100% of spoken content derives dynamically from data hubs or blueprints.

findings.title: Manifest Builder Imported Social Story from Deprecated Generator Script
findings.affected_runtime: Manifest rebuild & validator Source-Manifest Identity Gate
findings.impact: Manifest generation coupled to a retired script.
findings.evidence: scripts/build_w33_audio_manifest.mjs and whisper validator now read directly from src/data/weeks/week_33/read.js.
findings.required_fix: Remove import of tools/generate_w33_all_audio.mjs and import from read.js.
findings.closure_criteria: Zero imports from deprecated tools/ in manifest generation.

findings.title: Unprotected Competing Generator Scripts Could Overwrite Production Audio
findings.root_cause: 5 generator scripts remained executable and capable of overwriting public/audio/week33/ MP3s.
findings.impact: Accidental execution could corrupt multi-voice Cambridge audio.
findings.evidence: All 4 standalone scripts converted to fail-closed deprecation errors; universal script guarded against week 33.
findings.required_fix: Deprecate all legacy scripts with exit(1) fail-closed messages pointing to canonical generator.
findings.verification_method: Execute all 5 scripts and verify fail-closed exit code 1.
findings.closure_criteria: Zero competing scripts capable of overwriting W33 audio.

findings.title: Gate 15 Assertion & Freeze Manifest Hash Mutated Without Formal Amendment
findings.root_cause: Gate 15 spec updated to align with Speaking S1 routing, and W33_GOLDEN_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json hash updated inline in Step 1G.
findings.affected_runtime: Gate 15 test assertion and freeze guard
findings.impact: Baseline mutation without formal governance tracking.
findings.evidence: Formal AMENDMENT-W33-FREEZE-001 created in W33_MASTER_GOVERNANCE_MATRIX.json documenting reasons, old/new hashes, and zero-content-mutation proof.
findings.required_fix: Record formal freeze amendment with complete justification for Strategic Reviewer signoff.

findings.title: Physical MP3s on Disk Lacked Cryptographic Audit Manifest
findings.root_cause: No generation manifest existed linking on-disk MP3 hashes to source hub keys.
findings.impact: Physical MP3s were unverified against source hashes.
findings.evidence: W33_AUDIO_GENERATION_MANIFEST.json generated containing SHA-256 hashes and byte counts for all 54 assets.
findings.verification_method: Validate all 54 assets against on-disk files.
findings.closure_criteria: Cryptographic audit manifest published and committed.

findings.title: Acoustic Audio Playback Semantic Verification Gap
findings.root_cause: Need to prove acoustic transcripts match source data hubs without hallucination.
findings.impact: Spoken audio defects or mismatched prompts.
findings.evidence: 54/54 assets verified with Whisper STT; 9 adversarial self-tests and 4 drift tests pass with zero false-greens.
findings.required_fix: Enforce fail-closed Source-Manifest Identity Gate and semantic anchor validation.
findings.closure_criteria: Strategic Reviewer authorizes closure based on verified evidence.
